propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision findings including bugfix-size-attestation, forcing unnecessary code changes to re-trigger review
bugfix-size-attestation findings should be retrigger-eligible when the ticket carries a valid plan-review attestation, since the fix is ticket-side (rebar review-plan), not a code amend
the retrigger acceptance logic must read only the bot's own vote message and ticket store (not the requesting comment) and reuse the gate's own classifier and bucketing to avoid drift
a block with multiple findings or an attestation in FLAG_VERDICTS (absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid) or infra verdict must still refuse
parse failures (missing header, unparseable count, missing criterion line, unresolvable ticket id, classifier exception) must all refuse fail-closed
